2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/behaviour-ch.reason: the two rules contradicted each other and one had to move; the caveat admonition now sits where the admonition rule and the enforced shape rule always had it. The four science packages are frozen until their migration phase and each migrates its docstrings at its bump, since the rulebook a package obeys is the one it pins. Recorded in the changelog and in deferred.md
2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/behaviour-ch.overturn_when: a consumer bumps to this version without migrating the docstrings its own round then flags

2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/contract-dri.reason: the same design decision seen from the register: the rule's statement no longer says 'always' and now names the ratchet that holds a baselined page unit, but whether the code should instead be changed to meet the old claim is deferred to its own release
2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/contract-dri.overturn_when: the caps are made to bind on a baselined page unit, or the exemption is written into RULE.DOC.SHAPE itself

2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/contract-dri.reason: the same fleet consequence seen from the personas: both judging hats were rewritten in the same commit as the rule, which is what keeps the panel and the rulebook saying one thing. The consumers migrate at their bump, recorded in the changelog and in deferred.md
2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/contract-dri.overturn_when: a consumer bumps to this version without migrating the docstrings its own round then flags

2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/executing#6.reason: whether the 120-word and 3-admonition caps should bind on a page unit already in the baseline is a design decision, not a repair: it changes a hard scan's verdict over every consumer's corpus, so it belongs in its own commit and its own release, and it is carried in deferred.md
2026-09-09-audit-changes-01/executing#6.overturn_when: the caps are made to bind on a baselined page unit, or the exemption is written into RULE.DOC.SHAPE itself
